false_positive_note: Three of the five entries are false positives of the bigram heuristic rather than tolerated defects. That rate is stated here on purpose: a checker that cries wolf on its first real run gets switched off, and the mitigation is that each entry carries a judged reason and the gate reds only on NEW findings.
note: Entries leave this baseline by reconciling the manuscript, never by loosening the similarity threshold. Legitimate technical restatement is correct writing; rewording it to satisfy a cutoff makes the paper worse.
